strategy_outcome_calibration.min_samples_basis: distinct (task_id, episode_id) pairs, applied PER STATISTIC (benefit, each cost dimension, interval, each risk event)
strategy_outcome_calibration.note: experience calibration of the strategy-outcome prediction service, from CLOSED episodes IN THE WINDOW only; grouped by model identity/metric/unit/scope, risk events scored per event name, and the sample threshold counts DISTINCT EPISODES — kept separate from the legacy knowledge-prediction reliability (a knowledge hit rate never proves OR prediction accuracy), and never a model weight or a fitted calibrator. `groups` counts prediction-observation PAIRS; `occurrence` counts real OBSERVATION UNITS. A sample whose answer was LATER confirmed not to satisfy the task is counted under exclusions.validity_corrected and leaves the means — the stored evaluation itself is never rewritten

risk_reason_legend.class_not_recorded: the execution did not record this failure class
risk_reason_legend.environment_failure: an ENVIRONMENT failure (sandbox policy / missing module / unavailable backend)
risk_reason_legend.error_class_unknown: the failure's error_class is unknown/unrecorded: the cause is not inferred from the error text
risk_reason_legend.implementation_failure: the harness's OWN code failed (an implementation failure, NOT a modelling error)
risk_reason_legend.no_infeasibility: the solver did not report infeasibility here
risk_reason_legend.no_task_check: no task check is on record for this execution: task validity is UNKNOWN, never a failure
risk_reason_legend.predicted_without_probability: the prediction named the event but gave no probability: it is observed, not scored
risk_reason_legend.reported_infeasibility: the solver reported infeasibility (a verdict, not by itself a strategy failure)
risk_reason_legend.task_check_failed: a declared task check ran on real values and did not hold
risk_reason_legend.unpredicted_no_brier: the model did not predict this event: it is observed by the framework and counted in the occurrence rate, but no Brier score can be computed without a probability

selection.limit_basis: a DISPLAY ceiling, not a calibration sample size: the full window remains the calibration population
selection.basis: selected from the PUBLISHED block by relevance to the current retrieval, the candidates' declared methods and the current problem; no bank scan, no re-scoring

prediction_execution_pairs.ordering: by relevance to THIS decision (recall link, declared method, same task/cell, strategy hint); within a relevance rank, genuine failures and repairs before successes, then the most recent
prediction_execution_pairs.basis: derived from CLOSED episodes' stored evaluations in the current window; no model call, no re-scoring, no new storage
prediction_execution_pairs.note: relevance ranks failures/repairs before successes and the most recent first within a rank; a low relevance is a LOW RELEVANCE, never a claim that two methods are the same
prediction_execution_pairs.candidate_methods_absent: no candidate method description was supplied, so the selection degraded to recall-linked and recent representative pairs — it did NOT guess what a method means
